query: Please implement a network application for rapid development of high-performance protocol servers and clients. The application should have asynchronous event-driven functionality, support cross-platform development, and enable rapid development and maintenance of reliable network services. Users should be able to use the application to create custom protocol servers and clients, achieving high-performance data transfer and processing. Implement styling with frost white for the background and charcoal for components.
